title: Kinetics-Clock PINNs for Endogenous High-Frequency VO2 Switching Fronts
hook: A two-dimensional VO2 PINN may not need more spectral capacity to resolve a pulse-created switching front: at matched total parameter count, a physically constrained local kinetics clock can make the same front slower in the network coordinate while preserving the original electro-thermal-phase equations. The claim is deliberately narrower than a general coordinate-warp advantage and is tested against learned and analytic coordinate transforms as well as the strongest spectral, causal, weighting, and hard-constraint alternatives.
hook_shape_rationale: Shape (c), counter-intuitive minimalism: the candidate is no larger in total trainable parameters than the strongest matched solution network and adds no Fourier band, modal truncation, residual curriculum, or OOD-trained module; it reallocates capacity to one local coordinate map. Shape (a) was viable because switching-time and front-topology errors could fall sharply, but it was rejected as the hook because no measured magnitude exists yet.

gap_closure.gap: No retrieved frontier leaf establishes whether a 2D-or-higher PCM PINN can keep the electric, Joule-heating, thermal, and phase-kinetic residuals simultaneously accurate when a pulse creates moving fronts and new high-frequency modes after the initial condition — stakes: device researchers can accept the wrong switching time, programming energy, or phase topology despite a small aggregate loss, wasting compute and misdirecting device design.
gap_closure.how_closed: C12 replaces the raw nondimensional time slot by the bijective local clock τψ, while structural_prior_encoding constrains ∂tτψ to the prescribed phase-kinetic activity and pulls the complete original-coordinate PDE through that map; corpus support is thin in PINN/PCM, and the closest C12 exemplars are deep-network representation or operator swaps rather than coupled phase-front solvers.

core_mechanism: For each predeclared two-dimensional VO2 device case, write u=(V,T,ξ), E=-∇V, J=σ(T,ξ)E, QJ=J·E, and let Kξ(T,E,ξ,∇ξ,Δξ) be the signed right-hand side of the chosen phase-kinetic constitutive equation, all in the same nondimensionalization used by the FEniCSx reference model. Use the acyclic forward graph gψ(x,t)→τψ followed by hθ(x,τψ,p(t))→(V,T,ξ): gψ is evaluated first and never reads a predicted field, while the known pulse p(t) enters only the solution head. Realize the local clock without finite quadrature: on the nondimensional interval [0,tf], a coefficient network aψ(x) produces Mτ coefficients and τψ(x,t)=kfloor·t+Σj softplus(aψ,j(x))Bj(t), where bj(t)=exp(-((t-cj)/w)²), Bj(t)=∫0^t bj(s)ds is evaluated by its analytic erf expression, cj are uniformly fixed knots, w is their spacing, and kfloor=√εdtype·kref with kref>0. Thus τψ(x,0)=0 and ∂tτψ=kfloor+Σj softplus(aψ,j(x))bj(t)>0 exactly for the implemented map, so t↦τψ is strictly invertible at every x. Use Mτ=16 by default; select only from the predeclared training-validation grid {8,16,32}, with ties resolved toward the smaller Mτ, before formal OOD is opened. Define keff=√(Kξ²+kfloor²)>0 and add rτ=∂tτψ-keff(T,E,ξ,∇ξ,Δξ); although rτ couples gψ and hθ in the loss, the forward graph remains acyclic. For each scalar component f=hθ(x,τψ,p(t)), automatic differentiation evaluates ∂tf=fττt+fp·ṗ and ∂ttf=fτττt²+fττtt+2(fτp·ṗ)τt+fpp[ṗ,ṗ]+fp·p̈ on each open pulse-smooth interval, where the juxtaposed factors are contractions, not subscripts. It also evaluates the spatial Hessian D²xf=hxx+hxτ⊗∇τ+∇τ⊗hτx+fττ∇τ⊗∇τ+fτD²xτ, and Δf=tr(D²xf); this fixes the tensor shape rather than using ∇² for both a Hessian and a Laplacian. Substitute these derivatives into the original electric residual ∇·J=0, heat residual ρc∂tT-∇·(κ∇T)-QJ=0, phase residual ∂tξ-Kξ=0, and unchanged nonempty initial, boundary, and constitutive residual sets. At each declared pulse edge te, use one-sided pulse values, never differentiate through the jump, enforce T(x,te-)=T(x,te+) and ξ(x,te-)=ξ(x,te+), and enforce the electric boundary-value problem separately on both sides so V may follow an imposed electrical step; τ is continuous by its analytic construction. Conditional on the displayed differentiability and interface assumptions, this is an exact change of independent coordinate rather than replacement physics. The learnability claim remains empirical: if rτ is driven small where |Kξ| is large, τ advances rapidly and |∂ξ/∂τ| is normalized, but no approximation bound is claimed. All original residual normalizations, nonempty collocation counts, optimizer settings, and total parameter allocation are held fixed by shrinking hθ to pay for gψ, and formal OOD entities are touched only after architecture, hyperparameters, and stopping rule are locked.
core_mechanism_reasoning:
BLOCK 1 — PREMISES ledger:
P1. The prescribed 2D VO2 electro-thermal-phase model has a well-defined signed phase-rate Kξ whose high-magnitude regions mark the pulse-created switching activity; this is physically motivated by the constitutive closure but the claim that it identifies the representation bottleneck is untested — falsification target.
P2. Accumulated activity τψ is a useful local independent coordinate because ∂tτψ is strictly positive and therefore t↦τψ is invertible at each spatial point; positivity is by construction, while improved learnability is untested — falsification target.
P3. Conditional on gψ and hθ being twice differentiable between pulse edges and on retaining every displayed chain-rule term, the pulled-back residuals represent the same declared PDE case; pulse jumps are handled as interfaces rather than differentiated through.
P4. The synthetic FEniCSx reference is an oracle only for scoring within the declared constitutive model and is not experimental validation.
OBSERVATION-MODEL premise. Interior collocation points are sampled independently from the same predeclared uniform space-time distribution for every arm, with separate fixed initial and boundary samples; thus each Monte Carlo residual term targets the same domain integral, and neither solver labels nor formal-OOD outcomes steer the clock.
ESTIMAND. For each locked device case, the estimand is the unique numerical solution u*(x,t)=(V*,T*,ξ*) of the declared electro-thermal-phase initial-boundary-value problem; τψ is a nuisance coordinate, and the reported switching-time, phase-front Hausdorff, topology, energy-balance, field-error, and residual metrics are functionals of u* and the PINN solution over the predeclared case population.
BLOCK 2 — NAIVE-BASELINE AUDIT:
The runnable naive version is an equal-parameter PINN with an unconstrained learned monotone warp τ=g(x,t) and the original residual evaluated through automatic differentiation. Branch (i): it silently assumes an arbitrary smooth warp will place resolution where endogenous switching occurs, which is false because the front location and rate arise only after the coupled V→QJ→T→ξ solution develops; the candidate confronts that failure with rτ=∂tτ-keff and the complete original-coordinate pullback. Coordinate transformation is a standard tool, but this instance is not a textbook fixed warp because the useful clock rate depends on the unknown, spatially coupled phase kinetics while the electric elliptic equation, Joule source, parabolic heat equation, and phase equation must remain mutually consistent under one space-dependent map; learned and analytic coordinate-transform PINNs are therefore mandatory direct baselines, not omitted ancestors.
BLOCK 3 — design rationale:
The anchor stands alone: whole-entity OOD remains post-lock evaluation and neither residual-objective auditing nor a second method module is needed to make the coordinate claim falsifiable. Alternatives based on field/regime decomposition plus operator stacking, packet perturbation scores or bounds, solver-floor curricula or homotopy, and residual-space relabeling were rejected because they do not directly change how the endogenous front is represented; adaptive spectral/Fourier, causal/NeuSA, self-adaptive or loss-conditional weighting, and hard-constraint/AdamFLIP remain competitors rather than ingredients.
core_mechanism_steps:
1. Freeze one nondimensional 2D VO2 electric–Joule–thermal–phase initial-boundary-value model, its σ(T,ξ), κ(T,ξ), ρc(T,ξ), and Kξ constitutive functions, nonempty initial/boundary/interior sample sets, and a FEniCSx reference implementation; output the declared equations, units, pulse interfaces, one-sided interface conditions, and reference trajectories for scoring only.
2. Implement aψ(x) and the analytic positive-basis clock gψ with τψ(x,0)=0, kfloor=√εdtype·kref, fixed Gaussian bases bj, and analytic primitives Bj; use Mτ=16 by default and choose from {8,16,32} on training-validation only, breaking ties toward smaller Mτ. Input x and t; output scalar τψ plus exact automatic-differentiation derivatives, with ∂tτψ>0 by the displayed formula and no numerical quadrature.
3. Implement the capacity-matched solution head hθ(x,τψ,p(t)); input position, the already-produced clock, and the known pulse value, output V, T, and ξ, then compute E, J, and QJ deterministically from those fields.
4. Build one pullback routine that returns physical-time first and second derivatives, the 2×2 physical-space Hessian for each scalar field, and its trace when a Laplacian is required, including all τ–x and τ–p contractions; input hθ, gψ, and the one-sided p(t), and output derivatives in original coordinates.
5. Evaluate the original electric, heat, and phase residuals plus rτ on open pulse-smooth intervals; at every pulse edge enforce one-sided electric boundary conditions and continuity of T and ξ, while never differentiating p through its jump. Add the nonempty initial, boundary, and constitutive residuals, preserve the unmodified-coordinate normalizations, and jointly optimize ψ and θ from the first update.
6. Enforce matched total parameter allocation and matched nonempty collocation/optimizer budgets by reallocating hidden units from hθ to gψ; output checkpoints selected only by the predeclared in-distribution validation criterion.
7. Train mandatory same-bottleneck arms under matched budgets, including a same-architecture, same-parameter-allocation naive coordinate transform that uses the analytic monotone clock and full pullback but omits keff and rτ; also train the unmodified-coordinate MLP-PINN, analytic coordinate transforms, fixed-Fourier and adaptive-spectral PINNs, causal PINN and NeuSA, self-adaptive and loss-conditional weighting, and hard-constraint/AdamFLIP.
8. Run the identity negative control with the identical hθ architecture and nominal parameter/memory allocation by instantiating the same gψ tensors but freezing and bypassing them with τ=t; report both nominal and active-trainable counts, keep samples, pullback code, update count, wall-time cap, and optimizer fixed, and compare downstream fields/device metrics. The widened unmodified-coordinate arm in Step 7 separately reallocates the clock parameters to hθ and is the active-parameter-matched performance baseline.
9. On training-validation cases, report field error, switching-time error, phase-front Hausdorff and topology error, energy-balance error, worst normalized coupled residual, wall time, and memory; freeze every choice before opening formal-OOD whole geometries, material combinations, and pulse protocols.
10. Apply the locked solver procedure independently to each formal-OOD case and compare the same metrics without using OOD outcomes to alter gψ, hθ, baselines, thresholds, or stopping; output a bounded synthetic-numerical result rather than an experimental claim.
falsification_prediction: Generate a predeclared bank of 2D VO2 pulse-switching trajectories with the named FEniCSx model, then train the kinetics-clock PINN and all matched baselines on the training cases, select only on in-distribution validation, and score locked whole-case OOD afterward. If the mechanism works, switching-time absolute error, phase-front Hausdorff/topology error, energy-balance error, worst normalized coupled residual, and V/T/ξ field error should decrease relative to the unmodified-coordinate arm without a wall-time or memory claim being required. The one load-bearing variable is τψ(x,t), the learned accumulated kinetics clock; the sole negative-control intervention fixes gψ(x,t)=t in nondimensional units while leaving the head, budget, samples, and residual implementation unchanged, and predicts those downstream device metrics return toward the unmodified-coordinate PINN baseline. Failure of the clock arm to beat both that identity control and the learned/analytic coordinate-transform competitors, or failure of the identity intervention to remove the downstream gain, falsifies the claimed kinetics-specific mechanism.
compute_budget: 9.5 80GB-class GPU-days on one GPU for the bounded 2D FEniCSx data generation, matched training arms, three-seed replication, and locked post-selection OOD scoring; $0 paid API.

differentiation_from_lit.delta: NeuSA constructs a global truncated spectral state evolved by a NODE for canonical wave problems, whereas this candidate constructs a spatially local, strictly monotone kinetics coordinate jointly constrained by the phase-rate law and evaluates the unchanged VO2 electro-thermal-phase residuals through its full pullback.

The adaptive-spectral study varies Fourier frequencies and initial-condition gates for one stiff ODE, whereas this candidate changes the independent coordinate of a 2D coupled device PDE and retains every time- and space-derivative cross term induced by that local map.

The energy-embedded phase-field PINN obtains steady microstructures by replacing dynamic evolution with a static problem, whereas this candidate retains and scores the full pulse-driven switching trajectory, event timing, moving topology, and energy balance.

The operando VO2 work reveals sub-nanosecond electro-thermo-phase topology dynamics and supplies a physical target regime, whereas this candidate constructs a physics-residual neural coordinate solver whose claim is bounded to synthetic numerical closure rather than experimental validation.

what_step_was_missed: NeuSA would have needed to replace its single global physical-time coefficient flow with a spatially local monotone clock whose rate is coupled to the endogenous phase-kinetic right-hand side, then re-express the complete electric, heat, and phase residuals under that map rather than assuming a fixed global spectral evolution.
